contribution.position: My position on the reliability axis stands: the change is not ready. The perf report measures a 3.4% peak-load error rate against a 1% budget — a 3.4x overshoot. The test report (412 passed, 87% coverage) shows functional correctness but evidently does not capture peak-load behavior, so it cannot offset the reliability evidence. The incident log reinforces the concern: two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms, exactly the failure mode a token-refresh change at elevated error rates could aggravate.
